summary: {staffer} checks why a research participant had a hearing test before trying a retail aid.
realLife: A Pittsburgh audiologist tested a participant to confirm his eligibility for the case report. The researchers explained that their examination was a study step and that federal law allowed an eligible adult to buy an over-the-counter aid without it.
inGame: needs: purchase category, research protocol and store instructions.

turns.pulledBy: The store points to the research report as its authority.
turns.what: Staff asks which part actually describes a federal sales requirement.
turns.writesBack: The constituent gets the rule and the study procedure identified separately.

turns.what: The caseworker gives them the option of asking a hearing professional.
turns.writesBack: The household can decide when to schedule the visit.
